title: What it takes to build a calmer web
description: A small design team measures how lighter pages, readable type and fewer interruptions affect a reader’s ability to finish an article.

title: Inside a library’s workshop for repairing old laptops
description: Volunteers document each repair, share the fixes and set up refurbished computers for residents who need a machine at home.

title: A field guide to the sensors in an urban garden
description: Students compare soil moisture and temperature readings to see how different kinds of shade affect when plants need watering.

title: What a week of open data can tell a neighborhood
description: A volunteer team maps public repair requests, tracing which streets are quickest to get a broken light or a pothole fixed.

title: A studio publishes its design archive one page at a time
description: The team built a searchable home for old exhibition posters, with notes from the artists who made them.
